privateDeals.what: Grupo Carso (via Zamajal subsidiary Mx Delta NRG 1) signed binding agreement to buy TotalEnergies' 30% non-operated interest in Gulf of Mexico Block 30 (Kan discovery, est. 200-300 MMboe); Harbour Energy keeps 70% as operator; price undisclosed; subject to government approval
Zamajal bought an additional 30.1% of Talos Energy Mexico 7 (holder of 17.4% of the Zama field); Talos booked ~$49.7M proceeds in Q1 2026 (additional consideration reportedly contingent on first oil)
Talos Energy Q1 2026 10-Q: sale of part of its equity-method investment in Talos Energy Mexico 7 with $49.665M proceeds
Grupo Carso signed ~$1.99B contract with Pemex to drill 32 wells at the Ixachi gas/condensate field (Veracruz) over three years; Pemex payments start Jan 2027 from hydrocarbon sales
Slim said Grupo Carso and América Móvil would invest US$5 billion in Mexico in 2026 under a 'more aggressive' plan
Slim family/Control Empresarial took a stake in Turkcell ADSs (first 13G, event Mar 30, 2026; raised to ~6.4% by June 30, 2026)
